<js>
let src=JSON.parse(src)

	let lis=src.works.map(w=>({
		name:w.title,
		tags:	w.tags.map(t => t.i18n['zh-cn'].name || ''),     url:"https://api.asmr-200.com/api/workInfo/"+w.source_id,

		author:w.name,
		av:w.vas.map(i => i.name || '').join(',')
	}));
	
//	java.log(JSON.stringify(lis))
		
lis
</js>
